text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dis is a real pickle... What am I s'pposed
to do
now?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day while stopping by the arcade, I
come
across Tamamo Cross with an
apparent
conundrum on her hands.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, sorry, but I'm in some trouble
here!
Couldja help me out for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clink, jingle, clatter!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status—immense gains. There is no
indication that
the release of medals will
cease. Number of
acquired medals is
increasing substantially.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A phenomenal number of medals is
overflowing
from the medal game in
front of Mihono Bourbon.
They've
spilled out onto the floor and the
outflow
shows no signs of stopping.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Not good at all, Bourbon! The machine's
gotta be
broken!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Tamamo. Please allow me to
refute your
conjecture. Similar incidents
have occurred
previously.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I can confirm two preexisting instances
of such an
event, and thus conclude that
this machine is
operating as normal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clink, jingle, clatter!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status—immense gains. Rise in heart rate

identified. Detecting signs of elation.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Argh! We gotta stop dis! Imma go call da
staff!
Stay here 'n keep an eye on her,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Agh?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Beating a racing game is a
simple
matter for one fit to be a
princess!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You're amazing, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave the competition in a cloud of
dust! Out
of the way! TUUURRRN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh? The steering wheel came off...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami! Ya can't go handlin' the
wheel with
that much force!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look! There's a big red X flashing on my
screen!
It's so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That means yer goin' the wrong way,
Urara!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
D-dis is real bad! I can't deal with all
these
problems at once!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is there something wrong, Tamtam?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek? Great timin'!
Trainer! Us three
gotta curb this situation!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek? Great timin'!
Trainer! Us three
gotta curb this situation!
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺はブルボンを！
じゃあ私はブルボンを！
じゃあ俺はカワカミとウララを！
じゃあ私はカワカミとウララを！
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!
Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Roger! I'll come with!
Creek, take on
Kawakami 'n Urara!
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺はブルボンを！
じゃあ私はブルボンを！
じゃあ俺はカワカミとウララを！
じゃあ私はカワカミとウララを！
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!
Then I'll take Kawakami and Urara!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie. Good luck, you two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and I go and find a staff
member,
who then fixes the
malfunctioning medal game.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I apologize for
causing you
inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ey, don't worry about it. I'm just glad the

machine's workin' okay now.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. Recommencing

Operation: Medal Game.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What?! Hey, wait!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...We end up having to call the staff over
again.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, Trainer, that was great!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll come with ya! Creek, you
handle
Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okie-dokie. Good luck, you two!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo! Trainer! I really owe you guys!
Thanks to
you two, I made it over the
finish line!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I beat the game too! After I loosened up
and
released that tension, my cornering
became truly
elegant!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dat's real nice to hear. Just seein' your
smiles is
all the reward I need.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
One more time, Urara! Let's aim for some
real
speed!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami & Urara
text_block_list.text: Burn rubber!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And now they're forgettin' to
accelerate?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Tamtam, Trainer, that was great!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya really saved my hide back there,
Creek. And
Trainer, I'm sure glad you
dropped by when ya
did. I owe ya both
big time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't mention it! I was just on my
way home
after checking out the baby
goods section. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Baby goods?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My family's home is actually a day care
center, so
I really like browsing through
the baby section. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They even had some clothes that would suit you, Tamtam. ♪ Oh, I know! Let's go back and take a look together!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Somebody HELP MEEEE!
